title: After Trump Pardon, Former Honduras President Hernández Faces Charges in His Home Country
summary_full: Juan Orlando Hernández, a former president of Honduras, faces fraud and money laundering charges in his home country after a surprise Trump pardon overturned his drug-trafficking sentence in the U.S.
